subject.title: [Bug]: Dreaming deep promotion biased to stale 3-5 day old content; REM produces repetitive meta-themes; promotion gates bypassed via phase-signal boost

question: Should memory-core Dreaming continue allowing daily-only or grounded-only evidence to satisfy default deep promotion gates, or should durable promotion require real recall/query evidence by default?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally allow zero-recall daily signals to promote, but the issue and production confirmation show that policy can pollute durable memory; automation cannot choose that product tradeoff safely.

options.title: Keep daily/grounded eligibility with stricter filters
options.body: Preserve Dreaming-only promotion for users who rely on it, but tighten REM placeholder/meta-snippet filtering, diagnostics, and scoring safeguards before promotion.

options.title: Require real recall/query evidence
options.body: Change the default gates to require real recall/query evidence and update docs/tests, accepting that some Dreaming-only workflows may stop promoting until users tune config.

options.title: Add an explicit policy mode
options.body: Expose a clear promotion-policy choice so existing behavior can remain deliberate while stricter recall-only behavior becomes opt-in or migrated.

recommendation.title: Keep daily/grounded eligibility with stricter filters
recommendation.body: Preserve Dreaming-only promotion for users who rely on it, but tighten REM placeholder/meta-snippet filtering, diagnostics, and scoring safeguards before promotion.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored recent Dreaming-only promotion semantics and tests, making them the best available owner for the signal-policy choice.
